cards.limitations: 文中的优势结论基于特定真实市场数据与设定，尚未证明可推广至其他市场、时期或资产类别；对已知均值损失向量和协方差矩阵的闭式解依赖该较强假设；广义集合下虽可转化为凸优化，但计算可行性与样本外表现仍受矩未知程度与数据长度影响；权重系数的实践指引基于实证结果，不构成投资建议。
cards.summaryEn: Enhanced index tracking must outperform a benchmark while managing return and risk, yet the true joint distribution is typically unknown and only partial information is available. The authors build robust models that minimize a convex combination of worst-case mean loss and downside risk subject to a worst-case mean return constraint; closed-form solutions are derived when the mean loss vector and covariance matrix are known, while a more general set with unknown moments reduces to tractable convex optimization problems. Empirical results on real market data show that the proposed models outperform the tracked index, equally weighted portfolios, robust mean-variance models, and robust variance models in out-of-sample cumulative wealth and Sharpe, Sortino, and Omega ratios; portfolios minimizing the convex combination of worst-case mean loss and downside risk consistently outperform those minimizing downside risk alone. Practical guidance is also provided for selecting optimal weighting coefficients to balance risk and return.
cards.summary: 增强指数跟踪需在超越基准的同时管理收益与风险，但真实联合分布通常未知，仅能获得部分信息。作者构建稳健模型，目标为最坏情形平均损失与下行风险的凸组合，并约束最坏情形平均收益；对已知均值损失向量和协方差矩阵的集合给出闭式解，对矩未知的广义集合转化为可处理的凸优化问题。基于真实市场数据的实证结果显示，所提模型在样本外累计财富及夏普、索提诺、欧米伽比率上优于跟踪指数、等权组合及稳健均值方差和稳健方差模型；同时最小化最坏情形平均损失与下行风险凸组合的组合一致优于仅最小化下行风险的组合。作者还给出了选择最优权重系数的实践指引以平衡风险与收益。
cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses enhanced index tracking when the joint distribution of asset and index losses is unknown, proposing robust portfolio selection models guided by Pareto-optimality theory that trade off worst-case mean loss and downside risk under distributional uncertainty while constraining worst-case mean return.
cards.title: 分布不确定性下稳健增强指数跟踪组合选择
cards.description: 该研究针对资产与指数损失联合分布未知的增强指数跟踪问题，提出基于帕累托最优理论的稳健组合选择模型，在分布不确定性下权衡最坏情形平均损失与下行风险，并约束最坏情形平均收益。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study offers an actionable robust modeling framework for enhanced index tracking when the joint distribution is unknown in practice, helping balance return objectives and downside risk under limited distributional information and providing a reference for choosing risk-return trade-off weights.
cards.originalTitle: Robust enhanced index tracking portfolio selection under distributional uncertainty
cards.limitationsEn: The reported advantages are based on specific real market data and settings, and have not been shown to generalize to other markets, periods, or asset classes; the closed-form solution for the known mean loss vector and covariance matrix case relies on this relatively strong assumption; under the general set, although reducible to convex optimization, computational feasibility and out-of-sample performance still depend on the degree of unknown moments and data length; the practical guidance for weighting coefficients is based on empirical results and does not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Robust Enhanced Index Tracking Portfolio Selection under Distributional Uncertainty
keyPointsEn: Proposes robust enhanced index tracking models under distributional uncertainty, guided by Pareto-optimality theory, minimizing a convex combination of worst-case mean loss and downside risk subject to a worst-case mean return constraint.

Handles two uncertainty sets: closed-form solutions when the mean loss vector and covariance matrix are known, and a more general set with unknown moments that reduces to tractable convex optimization problems.

Empirical results on real market data show the proposed models outperform the tracked index, equally weighted portfolios, robust mean-variance models, and robust variance models in out-of-sample cumulative wealth and Sharpe, Sortino, and Omega ratios.
keyPoints: 提出分布不确定性下的稳健增强指数跟踪模型，基于帕累托最优理论，最小化最坏情形平均损失与下行风险的凸组合，并约束最坏情形平均收益。
分别处理两类不确定性集合：已知均值损失向量和协方差矩阵时给出闭式解；矩未知的广义集合可转化为可处理的凸优化问题。
真实市场数据实证显示，所提模型在样本外累计财富及夏普、索提诺、欧米伽比率上优于跟踪指数、等权组合、稳健均值方差模型和稳健方差模型。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为实际中联合分布未知的增强指数跟踪提供了可操作的稳健建模框架，有助于在有限分布信息下平衡收益目标与下行风险，并为选择风险收益权衡权重提供参考。

cards.limitations: 证据仅基于EURO STOXX 50指数期货2022至2025年的987个交易日，使用特定聚合窗口与几何表示；连续体结论及预测性能的泛化性需在其他资产、时期和方法下进一步验证。
cards.summaryEn: The paper analyzes deep limit order book data for EURO STOXX 50 index futures across 987 trading days from 2022 to 2025, using 30, 45, and 60-second aggregation windows and representing market states as symmetric positive definite covariance matrices. Under Log-Euclidean and affine-invariant geometries, the state cloud has an effective dimension of approximately 1.4, and 17 methods consistently favor a continuum over discrete regimes. The authors argue conventional regimes are coarse quantizations, with a dominant latent coordinate capturing 83.66% to 85.27% of variation and tracking VSTOXX.
cards.summary: 论文分析2022至2025年987个交易日的EURO STOXX 50指数期货深度限价订单簿数据，使用30、45、60秒聚合窗口，以对称正定协方差矩阵表示市场状态。在Log-Euclidean和仿射不变几何下，状态云有效维度约1.4，17种方法一致支持连续体而非离散制度。作者认为传统制度是粗量化，主导潜在坐标捕获83.66%至85.27%的变异并跟踪VSTOXX。
cards.descriptionEn: This study examines whether high-frequency limit order book dynamics exhibit discrete regimes or a continuum, finding an effective dimension of approximately 1.4 that supports a continuum over discrete regime structure.
cards.title: 限价订单簿动态中的潜在制度连续体
cards.description: 该研究检验高频限价订单簿动态中市场状态是离散制度还是连续体，发现有效维度约1.4，支持连续体而非离散制度结构。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If market states form a continuum, discrete regime models may lose information, whereas a continuous low-dimensional geometric representation could more stably capture market stress and improve forecasting.
cards.originalTitle: Latent Continuum of Regimes in Limit Order Book Dynamics
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based solely on EURO STOXX 50 index futures across 987 trading days from 2022 to 2025, using specific aggregation windows and geometric representations; the continuum conclusion and forecasting performance require further validation across other assets, periods, and methods.
cards.titleEn: Latent Continuum of Regimes in Limit Order Book Dynamics
keyPointsEn: The state cloud has an effective dimension of approximately 1.4, and 17 methods consistently support a continuum over discrete regimes.
A dominant latent coordinate captures 83.66% to 85.27% of variation in covariance-state geometry, tracking VSTOXX without regime labels.
Forecasting performance peaks near ten minutes, reaching a maximum pooled R2_OOS of 0.7483.
keyPoints: 状态云有效维度约1.4，17种方法一致支持连续体而非离散制度。
主导潜在坐标捕获83.66%至85.27%的协方差状态几何变异，无需制度标签即可跟踪VSTOXX。
预测性能在约10分钟处达到峰值，最大汇总R2_OOS为0.7483。
cards.whyItMatters: 若市场状态实为连续体，则离散制度模型可能丢失信息，连续低维几何表示或能更稳定地捕捉市场压力并改善预测。

cards.limitations: 结论基于UCR归档的142个数据集和特定对比算法，未涵盖所有时间序列类型或实际应用场景；自适应规则和超参数仅在二十个数据集的开发子集上调优，其泛化性需更多独立验证；与TabICLv2等组件的比较未涉及计算成本或可解释性分析。
cards.summaryEn: The paper presents TIGER, which applies three general-purpose classifiers (Ridge, Extra Trees, Naive Bayes) to four representation families, yielding twelve base learners, then combines their predictions via an adaptive meta-classification rule (weighted hard majority vote or TabICLv2). On 142 UCR datasets, TIGER is reported to achieve the best mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score among six compared algorithms, including HIVE-COTE 2.0. The authors argue its adaptive rule and single hyperparameter generalize, but the conclusions are based on a specific benchmark and experimental design.
cards.summary: 论文提出TIGER，将三种通用分类器（Ridge、Extra Trees、Naive Bayes）应用于四种表示家族，生成十二个基学习器，再通过自适应元分类规则（加权硬多数投票或TabICLv2）融合预测。作者在142个UCR数据集上报告，TIGER在平均准确率、平衡准确率和F1分数上优于包括HIVE-COTE 2.0在内的六种对比算法。作者认为其自适应规则和单一超参数具有泛化性，但结论基于特定基准和实验设计。
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes TIGER, which combines three general-purpose classifiers with four representation families and uses an adaptive meta-classification rule to improve time-series classification accuracy.
cards.title: TIGER：用上下文学习门控集成实现时间序列分类
cards.description: 提出TIGER方法，用三种通用分类器与四种表示家族组合，并通过自适应元分类规则提升时间序列分类精度。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work explores combining general-purpose classifiers with adaptive meta-learning for time-series classification, potentially offering new design ideas for ensemble methods and reducing reliance on representation-specific classifiers.
cards.originalTitle: TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on 142 datasets from the UCR archive and specific comparison algorithms, not covering all time-series types or practical scenarios; the adaptive rule and hyperparameter are tuned on a 20-dataset development subset, so generalization needs further independent validation; comparisons with components like TabICLv2 do not address computational cost or interpretability.
cards.titleEn: TIGER: Time-Series Classification with In-Context-Learning Gated Ensemble of Representations
keyPointsEn: TIGER uses a fixed small portfolio of general-purpose classifiers instead of tailoring a classifier to each representation family.

The final prediction comes from an adaptive meta-classification rule that chooses between weighted hard majority vote and TabICLv2, a pretrained tabular foundation model, based on the mean number of training samples per class.
On 142 UCR datasets, TIGER reports better mean accuracy, balanced accuracy, and F1-score than six compared algorithms.
keyPoints: TIGER采用固定的小型通用分类器组合，替代为每个表示家族定制分类器的做法。
最终预测由自适应元分类规则产生，根据每类平均训练样本数在加权硬多数投票与预训练表格基础模型TabICLv2之间选择。
在142个UCR数据集上，TIGER报告了优于六种对比算法的平均准确率、平衡准确率和F1分数。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作探索了将通用分类器与自适应元学习结合用于时间序列分类的可行性，可能为集成方法的设计提供新思路，并减少对特定表示定制分类器的依赖。

cards.limitations: 证据来自特定基准测试（困难编码任务等），替代模型与前沿模型的行为差异可能影响信号泛化性；AUROC等指标依赖所测试的模型与任务组合；未涵盖所有代理架构或工具类型；实时门控与反馈的收益幅度有限（+0.05至+0.30），且需并行运行替代模型增加成本；不确定性错误类型的默认集成策略未在所有场景验证。
cards.summaryEn: Tool calls by frontier LLM agents can fail silently, while chat APIs hide token probabilities, stated confidence is near chance, and resampling is ineffective due to high repetitiveness. The authors propose running a low-cost open-weight surrogate in parallel on the same context and action, recovering the missing signal through complementary readouts: teacher forcing, request-PMI, a discriminative verdict, and tool-choice competition. The readout is training-free, needs no internals, and reaches AUROC 0.825 on difficult coding tasks, supporting real-time gating and confidence feedback.
cards.summary: 前沿LLM代理的工具调用可能悄然出错，而聊天API隐藏token概率、模型自述置信度接近随机、重复采样因高重复性而无效。作者提出用并行运行的低成本开源替代模型读取相同上下文与动作，通过教师强制、请求PMI、判别式裁决和工具选择竞争等互补读出恢复缺失信号。该读出无需训练与内部访问，在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，并支持实时门控与置信度反馈。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a training-free, single-prefill method that leverages log-probabilities from a low-cost open-weight surrogate model to audit tool calls of black-box LLM agents, achieving an AUROC of 0.825 on difficult coding tasks and supporting real-time gating and confidence feedback deployment modes.
cards.title: 代理置信度：用小模型对数概率审计黑盒LLM代理
cards.description: 该研究提出一种无需训练、仅需一次预填充的方法，利用低成本开源替代模型的对数概率审计黑盒大模型代理的工具调用，在困难编码任务上将错误检测AUROC提升至0.825，并支持实时门控与置信度反馈两种部署模式。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method provides a practical error-auditing signal for black-box LLM agents without internals access, enabling real-time identification of untrustworthy tool calls at deployment or self-correction via confidence feedback, helping reduce risks from silent errors.
cards.originalTitle: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from specific benchmarks (e.g., difficult coding tasks); behavioral differences between surrogate and frontier models may affect signal generalization; AUROC and other metrics depend on tested model-task combinations; not all agent architectures or tool types are covered; gains from gating and feedback are modest (+0.05 to +0.30) and require running a surrogate model in parallel, adding cost; the ensemble default for unknown error types is not validated in all scenarios.
cards.titleEn: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
keyPointsEn: A low-cost open-weight surrogate recovers hidden token log-probabilities from frontier APIs; generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while a discriminative verdict catches holistically wrong calls.
Achieves AUROC 0.825 on difficult coding tasks, far above actor stated confidence (0.598), with generative readouts leading by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors.
Real-time gating improves accepted-action accuracy by +0.05 to +0.30 at 50% coverage; confidence feedback lifts task success on live-execution benchmarks by +0.119 and +0.137.
keyPoints: 低成本开源替代模型可恢复前沿API隐藏的token对数概率，生成式似然定位错误参数值，判别式裁决捕获整体错误调用。
在困难编码任务上达到AUROC 0.825，远超演员自述置信度(0.598)，生成式读出在另外三个演员上领先+0.07至+0.28。
实时门控在50%覆盖率下提升可接受动作准确率+0.05至+0.30，置信度反馈在实时执行基准上提升任务成功率+0.119和+0.137。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为无法访问内部概率的黑盒LLM代理提供了一种实用的错误审计信号，无需训练即可在部署时实时识别不可信工具调用，或通过置信度反馈让代理自我纠正，有助于降低静默错误带来的风险。

cards.limitations: 证据边界：研究仅基于一个特定标注框架和源自Plutchik分类法的人工标注真值，结论可能不推广到其他情感体系或领域；整体宏F1仅0.642，性能仍属中等；最佳方案依赖具体骨干模型与问题形式，未提供跨模型或跨数据集的普适性验证；合成数据增强与提示策略通过内在增强效用排序选择，可能存在选择偏差；未评估实际需求工程下游任务的效果。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The paper compares encoder fine-tuning (multi-label, binary ensemble) with decoder zero-/few-shot prompting under severe class imbalance, and tests loss reweighting, resampling, and generative data augmentation. The authors report that the best decoder few-shot prompting achieves macro-F1 0.642, baseline encoders lag far behind, but combining generative augmentation with positive-weighted loss closes most of the gap (+0.204) with up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency. Authors' view: large language models make fine-grained multi-label emotion classification feasible for requirements engineering, but the best formulation depends on backbone and problem formulation, and overall macro-F1 remains modest.
cards.summary: 事实：论文在严重类别不平衡下，对比了编码器微调（多标签、二元集成）与解码器零样本/少样本提示，并测试了损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强等策略。作者报告：最佳解码器少样本提示的宏F1为0.642，基线编码器大幅落后，但结合生成式增强与正加权损失后差距缩小（+0.204），且推理延迟低至三个数量级。作者观点：大语言模型使细粒度多标签情感分类在需求工程中可行，但最佳方案依赖骨干模型与问题形式，且整体宏F1仍不高。
cards.descriptionEn: This study compares encoder fine-tuning and decoder few-shot prompting for multi-label emotion classification of mobile app reviews and systematically evaluates imbalance mitigation strategies; its novelty lies in releasing the full experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints, providing a reproducible baseline for emotion-aware issue prioritization in requirements engineering.
cards.title: 大语言模型实现应用评论细粒度多标签情感分类
cards.description: 该研究比较了编码器微调与解码器少样本提示在移动应用评论多标签情感分类中的表现，并系统评估了类别不平衡缓解策略；其新意在于公开了完整实验流程、合成语料与微调检查点，为需求工程中的情感感知问题优先级排序提供了可复现的基线。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Fine-grained emotion classification can support requirements engineering activities beyond polarity analysis, such as emotion-aware issue prioritization and feature-oriented feedback analysis; the released pipeline, synthetic corpora, and checkpoints facilitate replication and reuse, offering an actionable baseline for automated app review analysis.
cards.originalTitle: Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: the study relies on a single annotation framework and human-labeled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, so conclusions may not generalize to other emotion schemes or domains; overall macro-F1 is only 0.642, indicating moderate performance; the best approach depends on the specific backbone and problem formulation, with no cross-model or cross-dataset generalizability validation; synthetic augmentation and prompting strategies are selected via intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking, which may introduce selection bias; downstream requirements engineering task effectiveness is not evaluated.
cards.titleEn: Large Language Models for Fine-Grained Multi-Label Emotion Classification of Mobile App Reviews
keyPointsEn: Baseline encoder fine-tuning (multi-label macro-F1 0.387; binary ensemble 0.450) falls far below the best decoder few-shot prompting (0.642).
Combining the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss improves by 0.204, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions (up to +0.501 F1).
The optimal formulation and mitigation strategy depend on the backbone and problem formulation, and encoder-based approaches reduce inference latency by up to three orders of magnitude.
keyPoints: 基线编码器微调（多标签宏F1 0.387；二元集成0.450）远低于最佳解码器少样本提示（0.642）。
将最佳多标签编码器与生成式数据增强和正加权损失结合，可提升0.204，且在稀有情感上增益最大（最高+0.501 F1）。
最优形式与缓解策略取决于骨干模型和问题形式，且编码器方案推理延迟比解码器低至多三个数量级。
cards.whyItMatters: 细粒度情感分类可支持超越极性分析的需求工程活动，如情感感知的问题优先级排序和面向功能的反馈分析；该研究公开的流程、合成语料与检查点有助于复现与复用，为应用评论自动分析提供了可操作的基线。

cards.limitations: 该研究仅在回归设定下证明树通过查询邻域影响决策，框架向分类或其他损失函数的推广尚不明确；实验基于合成报童实例和餐厅需求数据，结果依赖具体数据生成过程，且餐厅数据中平均成本差异统计不显著；算法性能可能随数据规模、树深度和查询邻域数量变化，未提供最坏情况保证。
cards.summaryEn: The paper studies how predictive multiplicity in decision trees affects local empirical distributions at a query point and proposes a joint Rashomon set and robustness optimization framework that simultaneously selects an operational decision and the largest Rashomon set, so that targets hold under the local empirical distribution induced by every retained tree. In the regression setting, the authors prove that a tree affects the decision only through the query neighborhood, the training observations sharing the query leaf, and develop a constraint generation algorithm combining query-path pricing with dynamic programming. Experiments on synthetic newsvendor instances and restaurant demand data show the algorithm typically needs few neighborhoods and runs substantially faster than full enumeration, with robust orders improving tolerated estimation loss and conditional value-at-risk.
cards.summary: 该论文研究预测多重性下决策树对查询点局部经验分布的影响，提出联合Rashomon集与鲁棒性优化框架，同时选择操作决策与最大Rashomon集，使目标在所有保留树的局部经验分布下成立。作者在回归设定下证明树仅通过训练观测共享的查询邻域影响决策，并开发结合查询路径定价与动态规划的约束生成算法。合成报童问题与餐厅需求数据实验表明，该算法通常只需少量邻域且比全枚举更快，鲁棒订单在容忍受估计损失与条件风险价值上有所改善。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a joint Rashomon set and robustness optimization framework that selects the largest set of decision trees among those fitting data almost equally well, ensuring that an operational decision meets prescribed cost, shortage, or risk targets regardless of which tree routes a query point; in the regression setting, it proves that trees affect the decision only through the query neighborhood and develops a constraint generation algorithm to avoid enumerating al
cards.title: 决策树最大Rashomon集用于鲁棒上下文优化
cards.description: 该研究提出联合Rashomon集与鲁棒性优化框架，在众多拟合数据几乎同样好的决策树中，选择最大的树集合，使得无论查询点被哪棵树路由，操作决策都能满足预设的成本、短缺或风险目标；在回归设定下，证明树只通过查询邻域影响决策，并开发约束生成算法避免枚举全部树。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a computable framework for robust decision-making under predictive multiplicity, enabling decision-makers to find decisions and their largest applicable tree sets that simultaneously guarantee risk and cost targets without enumerating all trees, thereby improving decision robustness and interpretability.
cards.originalTitle: Largest Rashomon sets of decision trees for robust contextual optimization
cards.limitationsEn: The proof that trees affect the decision only through the query neighborhood is established only in the regression setting, and extension to classification or other loss functions remains unclear. Experiments are based on synthetic newsvendor instances and restaurant demand data, so results depend on the specific data-generating processes, and the mean cost difference in the restaurant data is not statistically significant. Algorithm performance may vary with data size, tree depth, and number of query neighborhoods, and no worst-case guarantees are provided.
cards.titleEn: Largest Rashomon Sets of Decision Trees for Robust Contextual Optimization
keyPointsEn: Proposes a joint Rashomon set and robustness optimization framework that simultaneously selects an operational decision and the largest Rashomon tree set, ensuring prescribed targets hold under the local empirical distribution at the query point for every retained tree.

In the regression setting, proves that a decision tree affects the decision only through its query neighborhood, reducing the robust problem to finitely many distinct constraints that can be examined in order of increasing estimation loss.

Develops a constraint generation algorithm combining query-path pricing with dynamic programming; on synthetic newsvendor instances, it typically needs few neighborhoods and is substantially faster than full enumeration, and on restaurant demand data, robust orders increase mean tolerated estimation loss and reduce the conditional value-at-risk of the worst 10% of costs.
keyPoints: 提出联合Rashomon集与鲁棒性优化框架，同时选择操作决策与最大Rashomon树集，使预设目标在所有保留树的查询点局部经验分布下成立。
在回归设定下证明决策树仅通过查询邻域影响决策，将鲁棒问题转化为有限个不同约束，并可按估计损失递增顺序检查。
开发结合查询路径定价与动态规划的约束生成算法，在合成报童实例上通常只需少量邻域且显著快于全枚举；餐厅需求数据中鲁棒订单提升平均容忍估计损失并降低最差10%成本的条件风险价值。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为预测多重性下的鲁棒决策提供了可计算的框架，使决策者能在不枚举全部树的情况下，找到能同时保证风险与成本目标的决策及其最大适用树集，从而提升决策的稳健性和可解释性。

cards.limitations: 输入仅提供论文摘要，未给出实验设置、数据集、评估基准、人类评估者数量、统计显著性或复现细节，因此无法独立验证其优势幅度与泛化能力。此外，系统仍限于 LLM 可处理的代码实验场景，持久记忆可能引入历史偏差或过时策略，长期演化带来的错误累积与知识污染风险未被说明。
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that most AI scientist systems rely on static pipelines and cannot adapt from interaction history, causing missed directions and repeated failures. EvoScientist combines a Researcher, an Engineer, and an Evolution Manager with ideation and experimentation memories; the authors report better novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity than seven open-source and commercial systems, plus higher code execution success rates. Note that the input provides no numerical margins, evaluation scale, or statistical significance, so these effects are author-reported.
cards.summary: 论文指出多数 AI 科学家系统依赖静态流水线，无法根据交互历史调整策略，容易忽略方向、重复失败。EvoScientist 由研究员、工程师和演化管理三个智能体组成，并配备构思记忆与实验记忆两套持久模块；作者报告其在自动与人工评估的想法生成指标上优于 7 个开源与商业系统，并提升代码执行成功率。需要说明的是，具体对比数字、评估规模与统计显著性在输入摘要中未给出，以上效果均属作者报告。
cards.descriptionEn: EvoScientist proposes an evolving multi-agent framework in which persistent memory lets research ideas and experimental strategies improve over time instead of following a static hand-designed pipeline. Its contribution is a reusable knowledge distillation mechanism that may reduce repeated failed experiments and improve the executability of research ideas.
cards.title: EvoScientist：持久记忆驱动多智能体AI科学家自我进化
cards.description: EvoScientist 提出一个演化型多智能体框架，通过持久记忆让研究想法与实验策略随时间自我改进，而非沿用静态手工流水线。其贡献在于引入可复用知识蒸馏机制，有望减少重复失败实验并提高研究想法的可执行性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If persistent memory can reliably reuse past successes and failures, end-to-end discovery systems could shift from one-shot pipelines toward continual learning, lowering repeated trial-and-error costs and improving idea quality with use.
cards.originalTitle: EvoScientist: Towards Multi-Agent Evolving AI Scientists for End-to-End Scientific Discovery
cards.limitationsEn: Only the paper abstract is provided; experimental settings, datasets, evaluation benchmarks, number of human evaluators, statistical significance, and reproduction details are absent, so the reported advantages cannot be independently verified. The system also remains limited to code-based experiments that an LLM can handle, and persistent memory may introduce historical bias or outdated strategies; long-term error accumulation and knowledge contamination risks are not addressed.
cards.titleEn: EvoScientist: Persistent Memory Enables Self-Evolving Multi-Agent AI Scientists
keyPointsEn: Three specialized agents: a Researcher generates ideas, an Engineer implements and executes experiments, and an Evolution Manager distills reusable knowledge from past interactions.
Dual persistent memory: ideation memory records feasible and previously unsuccessful research directions, while experimentation memory stores effective data processing and training strategies.
The authors report outperforming seven open-source and commercial systems on novelty, feasibility, relevance, and clarity, and improving code execution success rates.
keyPoints: 三大智能体分工：研究员生成想法，工程师实现执行，演化管理从历史交互中提炼可复用知识。
双持久记忆：构思记忆记录可行方向与失败方向，实验记忆保存有效数据处理与训练策略。
作者报告其在想法新颖性、可行性、相关性和清晰度上优于 7 个开源与商业系统，并提升代码执行成功率。
cards.whyItMatters: 若持久记忆能稳定复用历史成功与失败经验，端到端科学发现系统或可从一次性流水线转向持续学习，降低重复试错成本，并让研究想法的质量随使用时间提升。

cards.limitations: 研究基于单一六年开发窗口（2016-2021）的八个美国上市ETF，样本有限。事后拆分不在预注册协议内，不能建立因果关系。损失不能归因于覆盖不足，杠杆上限和熊市是更简单解释。块自举区间在多数对比中包含零，统计显著性弱。结论外推需谨慎，不构成投资建议。
cards.summaryEn: The study proposes a Conformal Kelly rule that reads the conformal interval half-width as the scale in a capped fractional-Kelly position-sizing rule, evaluated under a pre-registered protocol. On the sealed 2022-2024 window, realized coverage was 0.745 versus a 0.750 target, but the two final configurations' annualised net log growth was 8.5% and 7.0%, below an unlevered equal-weight book and leveraged passive books, ranking last. The authors note that passing coverage did not translate into economics, and a post-hoc split shows conditional coverage failure, with 2022 under-coverage potentially constrained by a binding leverage cap rather than causing losses.
cards.summary: 研究提出Conformal Kelly规则，用共形区间半宽作为仓位缩放尺度，并在预注册协议下评估。在封闭的2022-2024窗口，实际覆盖率为0.745接近0.750目标，但两个最终配置的年化净对数增长仅为8.5%和7.0%，低于无杠杆等权组合和杠杆被动组合，排名靠后。作者认为，覆盖率达标但经济表现不佳，且事后拆分显示条件覆盖失败，2022年覆盖不足可能受杠杆上限约束而非直接导致损失。
cards.descriptionEn: A pre-registered study uses conformal prediction interval half-widths as scaling factors in a capped fractional-Kelly rule, evaluated on sealed 2022-2024 data, finding coverage near target but underperformance versus passive benchmarks and conditional coverage failure.
cards.title: 共形区间宽度作为仓位缩放因子的预注册检验
cards.description: 一项预注册研究将共形预测区间半宽用作封顶分数凯利规则的缩放因子，在封闭的2022-2024数据上检验其覆盖率与经济学表现，发现边际覆盖达标但增长落后于被动基准，并暴露条件覆盖失败。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This study provides a pre-registered empirical counterexample to using conformal prediction interval widths directly as position-sizing scales: marginal coverage does not guarantee economic performance and may mask conditional coverage failure. It suggests that quantitative researchers relying on interval width as a risk scale should also test conditional coverage and account for practical trading constraints such as leverage caps.
cards.originalTitle: When Marginal Coverage Transfers and the Economics Do Not: A Pre-Registered Study of Conformal Interval Widths as Position-Sizing Scales
cards.limitationsEn: The study is based on a single six-year development window (2016-2021) of eight US-listed ETFs, with limited sample size. The post-hoc split is outside the registered protocol and cannot establish causation. Losses cannot be attributed to under-coverage; leverage cap and bear market are simpler accounts. Block-bootstrap intervals include zero for most contrasts, indicating weak statistical significance. Conclusions should be extrapolated with caution and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Pre-Registered Study of Conformal Interval Widths as Position-Sizing Scales: Marginal Coverage Transfers but Economics Do Not
keyPointsEn: On the sealed 2022-2024 data, coverage was 0.745 versus a 0.750 target, but the two configurations' annualised net log growth (8.5% and 7.0%) was below an equal-weight book (9.5%) and leveraged passive books (15.6-16.8%).

A post-hoc non-registered split shows conditional coverage failure: average coverage was 0.592 in 2022 and 0.842 afterward, but losses cannot be attributed to under-coverage because the leverage cap bound daily and an equity bear market is a simpler explanation.

On the development window, a slow per-asset conformal quantile out-grew all locally adaptive alternatives under a binding leverage cap, but block-bootstrap intervals include zero for 11 of 13 re-derivable contrasts.
keyPoints: 在封闭的2022-2024数据上，覆盖率为0.745，接近目标0.750，但两个配置的年化净对数增长（8.5%和7.0%）低于等权组合（9.5%）和杠杆被动组合（15.6-16.8%）。
事后非注册拆分显示条件覆盖失败：2022年平均覆盖仅0.592，2023-2024为0.842，但损失不能归因于覆盖不足，因为杠杆上限每天绑定且股市熊市是更简单解释。
开发窗口上，慢速逐资产共形分位数在杠杆上限约束下优于所有局部自适应替代方案，但块自举区间在13个可重导对比中有11个包含零。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究为将共形预测区间宽度直接用作仓位缩放因子的做法提供了预注册的实证反例：边际覆盖率达标并不保证经济表现，且可能掩盖条件覆盖失败。这提示量化研究者，在依赖区间宽度作为风险尺度时，需同时检验条件覆盖，并考虑杠杆约束等实际交易限制对策略表现的影响。

cards.limitations: 模型建立在损失有界且Lipschitz、硬阈值以及特定核函数等假设之上，现实金融网络的损失过程与阈值行为可能偏离这些条件。结论主要针对所设定的动态系统与极限理论，并未声称能预测真实危机或给出政策建议。数值实验与EBA应用仅针对特定数据与参数，不能直接外推为一般性经验规律或投资结论。
cards.summaryEn: The author develops a dynamic model in which losses flow through weighted directed networks while counterparties are distressed, with recovery and repeated threshold crossings built into the same system; K exposure factors close the N-institution dynamics through K feedback coordinates while preserving heterogeneous sender and receiver roles. For bounded Lipschitz losses, Wasserstein stability and aligned L1 kernel estimates connect finite populations, factor models, and directed-kernel limits, with separate bounds for sampling and exposure approximation. For the hard threshold, every bounded nonnegative kernel admits a greatest cumulative-distress solution selected by vanishing positive-side regularization; stability is governed by the mass of institutions near the threshold, and an Osgood condition along one reference path yields uniqueness, quantitative perturbation bounds, and convergence under sampled latent labels.
cards.summary: 作者提出一个动态模型，让损失在加权有向网络中流动，并将恢复与重复阈值穿越纳入同一系统；用K个暴露因子将N家机构的动态闭合为K个反馈坐标，同时保留发送方与接收方的异质性。在损失有界且Lipschitz的条件下，作者用Wasserstein稳定性和对齐的L1核估计连接有限总体、因子模型与有向核极限，并分别给出采样误差与暴露近似误差的界。对于硬阈值，作者证明每个有界非负核都有最大的累积困境解，可由正侧正则化消失选取；稳定性由阈值附近机构质量决定，沿一条参考路径的Osgood条件给出唯一性、定量扰动界与采样潜在标签下的收敛。
cards.descriptionEn: The study builds a dynamic distress-contagion model in which losses flow through weighted directed networks while institutions have heterogeneous buffers and stress persists, incorporating recovery and repeated threshold crossings. Its novelty lies in closing N-institution dynamics through K exposure factors and connecting finite populations, factor models, and directed-kernel limits via Wasserstein stability and aligned L1 kernel estimates; its usefulness lies in linking thr
cards.title: 异质金融网络中动态阈值困境传染的低秩与图极限
cards.description: 该研究在加权有向网络、异质机构缓冲与持续压力共存的设定下，构建了一个带恢复和重复阈值穿越的动态困境传染模型。其新意在于用K个暴露因子闭合N家机构的动态，并给出有限总体、因子模型与有向核极限之间的Wasserstein稳定性与L1核估计；有用性在于将阈值附近机构质量与唯一性/扰动界联系起来，并应用于EBA主权持仓的共暴露因子与组合扰动敏感性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework provides an analytically tractable bridge for understanding how network structure, the distribution of institutional buffers, and stress duration jointly determine stability in financial distress contagion, and it permits low-rank factor approximations of large heterogeneous networks. For regulation and risk analysis, the mass of institutions near the threshold can serve as a key quantity for assessing uniqueness and perturbation sensitivity, and the EBA sovereign-holdings application demonstrates a feasible path from disclosed data to common-exposure factors and quantification of portfolio perturbation sensitivity.
cards.originalTitle: Low-rank and graphon limits for dynamic threshold distress contagion in heterogeneous financial networks
cards.limitationsEn: The model relies on assumptions such as bounded Lipschitz losses, a hard threshold, and specific kernel conditions, and real financial networks may deviate from these. The results concern the specified dynamic system and limiting theory; they do not claim to predict actual crises or provide policy advice. The numerical experiments and EBA application are tied to particular data and parameters and cannot be directly extrapolated into general empirical regularities or investment conclusions.
cards.titleEn: Low-rank and graphon limits for dynamic threshold distress contagion in heterogeneous financial networks
keyPointsEn: K exposure factors close the N-institution dynamics while preserving heterogeneous sender and receiver roles, and the same system incorporates recovery and repeated threshold crossings.

For bounded Lipschitz losses, Wasserstein stability and aligned L1 kernel estimates connect finite populations, factor models, and directed-kernel limits, with sampling and exposure-approximation errors bounded separately.

For the hard threshold, the greatest cumulative-distress solution is selected by vanishing positive-side regularization; threshold-layer mass controls uniqueness, perturbation bounds, and convergence under sampled labels via an Osgood condition, and rank-one examples show the criterion is sharp.
keyPoints: 用K个暴露因子闭合N家机构的动态，保留异质发送方与接收方角色，并同时刻画恢复与重复阈值穿越。
在损失有界Lipschitz下，以Wasserstein稳定性与对齐L1核估计连接有限总体、因子模型与有向核极限，误差界分开处理采样与暴露近似。
硬阈值下最大累积困境解由正侧正则化消失选取；阈值层质量通过Osgood条件控制唯一性、扰动界与抽样标签收敛，秩一例子表明该判据具有尖锐性。
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架为理解金融困境传染中网络结构、机构缓冲分布与压力持续时间如何共同决定系统稳定性提供了可分析的数学桥梁，并允许用低秩因子近似大规模异质网络。对监管与风险分析而言，阈值附近机构质量可作为评估唯一性与扰动敏感性的关键量，EBA主权持仓应用展示了从披露数据构造共暴露因子并量化组合扰动敏感性的可行路径。

cards.limitations: 结论基于特定环境：5分钟平均聚合的BTC/USDT限价订单簿数据、无摩擦回放及终端紧迫惩罚使提前清算近乎无成本。作者明确指出在该环境下专家划分并非抑制崩溃所必需，可能掩盖训练设定失败而非提供内在性能优势。跨种子离散度在K=8时最低但非单调，且未经族系调整后不稳健。失败模式归因在30与100种子间发生反转，说明结果对种子数量敏感，需更多独立数据与市场条件验证。
cards.summaryEn: The paper evaluates vanilla DDQL, K-means-partitioned MoE (K=2,4,8), and parameter-matched dense networks on 5-minute aggregated BTC/USDT limit order book data. Facts: no learned configuration significantly improves mean implementation shortfall over DDQL; annealed exploration alone eliminates collapse from 12/100 to 0/100 (McNemar p=4.9e-4); K=8 MoE does not collapse under any of six specifications. The authors argue expert partitioning is unnecessary to suppress collapse and may mask a training-specification failure, while K=8 shows lowest but non-monotone across-seed dispersion and tail risk worsens monotonically with K.
cards.summary: 论文在BTC/USDT限价订单簿5分钟聚合数据上比较了原始DDQL、K-means划分的专家混合（K=2,4,8）以及参数匹配的密集网络。事实：没有任何学习配置在平均实现短缺上显著优于DDQL；退火探索单独将崩溃从12/100消除至0/100（McNemar p=4.9e-4）；K=8专家混合在所有六种设定下均未崩溃。作者认为专家划分并非抑制崩溃的必要条件，可能掩盖了训练设定的失败，且K=8的跨种子离散度最低但非单调，尾部风险随K单调恶化。
cards.descriptionEn: This study uses repeated-seed experiments to show that apparent architectural gains of mixture-of-experts in order-execution reinforcement learning may stem from training specifications rather than architecture; annealed exploration alone eliminates policy collapse, and K=8 MoE does not collapse under any specification, but tail risk worsens with increasing K.
cards.title: 专家混合在加密货币订单执行中的失败模式与训练稳定性
cards.description: 该研究通过多种子重复实验揭示了专家混合架构在订单执行强化学习中的表观优势可能源于训练设定，而非架构本身；退火探索即可消除策略崩溃，而K=8专家混合并未在任意设定下崩溃，但尾部风险随专家数增加而恶化。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study highlights the importance of repeated-seed evaluation to distinguish architectural effects from training-specification effects. In an environment where frictionless replay and terminal-urgency penalty make early liquidation nearly costless, apparent architectural improvements may be artifacts of favorable training realizations. The monotonic relationship between tail risk and K suggests that increasing expert count may reduce across-seed dispersion but exacerbate per-policy tail risk, a caution for risk-sensitive order-execution applications.
cards.originalTitle: Mixture-of-Experts for Cryptocurrency Order Execution: Training Stability, Tail Risk, and Failure Modes
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on a specific environment: 5-minute mean-aggregated BTC/USDT limit order book data, frictionless replay, and a terminal-urgency penalty making early liquidation nearly costless. The authors explicitly state that expert partitioning is not necessary to suppress collapse in this environment and may mask a training-specification failure rather than confer intrinsic performance benefits. Across-seed dispersion is lowest at K=8 but non-monotone and not robust to family-wise adjustment. Failure-mode attribution reverses between 30 and 100 seeds, indicating sensitivity to seed count and the need for validation on more independent data and market conditions.
cards.titleEn: Failure Modes and Training Stability of Mixture-of-Experts for Cryptocurrency Order Execution
keyPointsEn: No learned configuration, including MoE, significantly improves mean implementation shortfall over vanilla DDQL; all are higher than TWAP (0.39 bps) and immediate liquidation (0.21 bps).
Annealed exploration alone eliminates observed policy collapse (12/100 to 0/100), matching the effect of expert partitioning; but combining annealed exploration with aligned reward restores collapse.
K=8 MoE does not collapse under any of the six tested specifications, yet within-policy tail risk worsens monotonically with expert count K.
keyPoints: 在平均实现短缺上，所有学习配置（包括专家混合）均未显著优于原始DDQL，且均高于TWAP（0.39 bps）和立即清算（0.21 bps）。
退火探索单独即可完全消除观察到的策略崩溃（12/100降至0/100），效果与专家划分相当；但组合退火探索与对齐奖励反而恢复崩溃。
K=8专家混合在所有测试的六种设定下均未崩溃，但策略内尾部风险随专家数K增加而单调恶化。
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究强调重复种子评估对于区分架构效应与训练设定效应的重要性。在无摩擦回放和终端紧迫惩罚使提前清算近乎无成本的环境中，表面上的架构改进可能只是有利训练实现的产物。尾部风险与K的单调关系提示，增加专家数虽可降低跨种子离散度，却可能加剧单策略尾部风险，这对风险敏感的订单执行应用具有警示意义。

cards.limitations: 该摘要仅提供方法概述与总体实证结论，未披露具体数据集范围、回测区间、交易成本假设、基线设置细节及统计显著性。报告结果限于作者所选的A股与美股市场及所评估基线，不能推断到其他市场、资产类别或实盘环境。池级奖励训练涉及偏好学习，其稳定性与超参数敏感性未在摘要中说明。此外，摘要未讨论过拟合风险、因子衰减或容量约束。
cards.summaryEn: The authors identify three issues in existing formulaic alpha generation frameworks: individual formula generation ignores pool context and complementarity; formula-wise generation lacks a unified mechanism to preserve and revise structures at different levels; and pool-level rewards cannot be differentiated directly through symbolic evaluation to train the generator. They propose AlphaPADI, which combines grammar-constrained pool candidate initialization, pool-aware hierarchical diffusion that reconstructs complete pools at multiple structural scales under the current pool context, and reward-guided pool refinement that evaluates joint predictive performance and inner diversity. Empirical results on the Chinese and U.S. stock markets are reported to outperform evaluated baselines in predictive and portfolio performance, supporting pool-aware generation as an effective framework for automated alpha discovery.
cards.summary: 作者指出，已有公式化Alpha生成框架存在三个问题：生成个体公式时未考虑池上下文与公式间互补性；公式级生成缺乏跨层级结构的保持与修订机制；池级奖励无法通过符号评估直接微分以训练生成器。为此提出AlphaPADI，核心是语法约束的池候选初始化、在当前池上下文下跨结构尺度重建完整池的分层扩散，以及结合联合预测性能和内部多样性的奖励引导池精炼。作者报告在中国和美国股票市场上，AlphaPADI在预测和组合表现上优于所评估的基线，认为池感知生成是自动化Alpha发现的有效框架。
cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces AlphaPADI, a framework that incorporates alpha-pool context into the generative state through grammar-constrained buffer initialization, pool-aware hierarchical discrete diffusion, and reward-guided pool refinement. Unlike RL or GFlowNet approaches that generate formulas individually, it models inter-formula complementarity during generation and reports improved predictive and portfolio performance on Chinese and U.S. stock markets.
cards.title: AlphaPADI：池感知分层离散扩散用于公式化Alpha发现
cards.description: 该工作提出AlphaPADI框架，首次将Alpha池上下文纳入生成状态，通过语法约束缓冲初始化、池感知分层离散扩散和奖励引导池精炼三个组件，在生成阶段直接建模公式间的互补性。相比单独生成公式的强化学习或生成流网络方法，它提供了一种池级别的生成与优化机制，在A股与美股数据上报告了预测和组合表现的改进。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Formulaic alphas are typically deployed as pools, where each formula's value depends on its incremental contribution to joint predictive performance. By modeling complementarity directly in the generation process and using pool-level rewards for training, AlphaPADI offers a shift from individual formula generation toward pool-level generation, which may help reduce redundant formulas and improve information gain at the portfolio level.
cards.originalTitle: AlphaPADI: Formulaic Alpha Discovery via Pool-Aware Hierarchical Discrete Diffusion
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract provides only a high-level method overview and aggregate empirical claims; it does not disclose specific dataset scope, backtest period, transaction cost assumptions, baseline configuration details, or statistical significance. Reported results are limited to the authors' selected Chinese and U.S. stock markets and evaluated baselines, and cannot be extrapolated to other markets, asset classes, or live trading. Pool-level reward training involves preference learning, whose stability and hyperparameter sensitivity are not described in the abstract. Overfitting risk, factor decay, and capacity constraints are also not discussed.
cards.titleEn: AlphaPADI: Pool-Aware Hierarchical Discrete Diffusion for Formulaic Alpha Discovery
keyPointsEn: Incorporates alpha-pool context into the generative state rather than generating formulas in isolation.
Uses grammar-constrained initialization and hierarchical discrete diffusion to reconstruct candidate pools at multiple structural scales.
Trains the reverse model via reconstruction and preference learning using joint predictive performance and inner diversity rewards.
Reports baseline comparisons on predictive and portfolio performance in Chinese and U.S. stock markets.
keyPoints: 将Alpha池上下文纳入生成状态，而非孤立地生成单个公式。
采用语法约束初始化与分层离散扩散，在多个结构尺度上重建候选池。
通过重建与偏好学习，利用联合预测性能和内部多样性奖励训练反向模型。
在中国和美国股票市场上报告了预测与组合表现的基线对比结果。
cards.whyItMatters: 公式化Alpha通常以池的形式部署，单个公式的价值取决于其对联合预测的增量贡献。AlphaPADI把互补性直接建模进生成过程，并试图用池级奖励指导训练，为自动化Alpha发现提供了一种从个体生成转向池级生成的思路，可能有助于减少冗余公式并提升组合层面的信息增益。
